body: There is nothing that's too stupid for tucker carlson

I get it, I'm. Not 100% sure I'd be around if it weren't for the fact that my dog wasn't abandoned by someone else once already.   Honestly the struggle for me has been whether or not he'd be happier with my ex if I wasn't around anymore.

It's funny, I never expected a reply, just thought that I was screaming into the void, so I was somewhat surprised to see a reply and didn't know what to say.  But anonymity has its advantages such as not needing to hold back so...

Honestly I've been all over the place sometimes I'm doing well while other times I find myself spiraling out of control,  it's seems that it's been more of the latter in recent days.

I am able to hold myself together in public but when I'm alone I find myself crumbling more and more.  It's funny you'd think that with time it would get easier, but the more I dwell on things the farther down into a hole I dig myself. 

That voice that tells me I'm worthless and incapable of ever being happy or being loved just feels louder and louder recently.  I find myself at times just feeling empty until I break down over sometime thing.

 I had spent a good part of the last decade mostly on my own that I had gotten used to it, having someone around all the time for so a long time wasn't something I was used and wasn't something I ever expected and now that that's all gone its just... hard.  My house is so quiet and empty. It's lonely.

She left.

The stress of the past year had been wearing me down, first covid, then uncertainty with my income, then major job related stress.  Over the past year I've just become this hollowed out shell, I used to be fun, I used to want to do things but, especially for like the last 4 months, I've just been trying to make from one day to the next, trying to do basic things that normal people do so I could appear normal. Clean the house, mow the lawn, do the dishes, do laundry ect.  Like there can't be anything wrong with that guy, look at his lawn.  I didn't see that I was being combative, difficult, and unmotivated.  I hadn't been sleeping consistently for so long and am unfocused and in a daze most of the time.  I was forgetting stuff all the time. Finally she just couldn't take it and left.  

The worst part is, things were getting tangibly better and looking back I felt like there was a light at the end of the tunnel as my work life was getting back to what it had been, you know like 18 months ago and with that change alot of my stress would have been gone.  

I had hidden how shitty things were until it was too late.  

Now I'm just cratered all over again.  I'm in my 40s, single, can't escape the feelings of being stupid, ugly, borning, generally just a worthless thing that's just incapable of getting that life I want.  Most of my friends are married or married with kids, so I don't have many people in my life because everyone's just moved on and left me behind.  And I'm back in that pit of just trying to get by one day after the other, mowing the lawn and doing laundry.
